title: Weekly View: Reschedule Jobs — Frontend Drag-and-Drop
tech: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, CSS Modules, Axios, @dnd-kit/core
keyConstraints: TypeScript strict mode, Zod validation server-side, .nullish() not .optional().nullable(), Prisma selects must include all returned fields (jobInclude is source of truth), no UI component libraries, CSS Modules only
description: Add drag-and-drop rescheduling to the JobsPage weekly calendar view. Admin and Dispatcher users can drag a job card from one day column to another; the drop preserves the existing HH:MM from scheduledStart in Europe/Helsinki timezone (defaulting to 08:00 if scheduledStart is null), then calls PATCH /api/jobs/:id/schedule with the new scheduledStart ISO string. Driver users see read-only cards. Uses @dnd-kit/core which is already installed. Follow the existing DispatcherBoard Schedule-view DnD pattern as the reference implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: In week view, job cards for Admin and Dispatcher roles are draggable via @dnd-kit/core (DndContext wrapping weekGrid, useDraggable per card, useDroppable per day column); Driver role sees read-only cards with no drag attributes

On drop to a different day column: preserves HH:MM from the card's existing scheduledStart in Europe/Helsinki timezone (defaults to 08:00 if scheduledStart is null), constructs a new UTC ISO string for the target date, and calls PATCH /api/jobs/:id/schedule via axiosInstance
Optimistic update: card moves to the new day column immediately on drop; reverts to original column and shows an inline error message if the API call fails
A DragOverlay renders a ghost clone of the weekJobCard while dragging; the hovered day column receives a visible CSS highlight class
COMPLETED job cards are non-draggable; cards with status DRAFT, ASSIGNED, or IN_PROGRESS are draggable
npx tsc --noEmit passes with no errors
implementationNotes: Reference implementation: frontend/src/pages/DispatcherBoard/DispatcherBoard.tsx — the Schedule view uses DndContext, DroppableDayColumn (useDroppable with id = 'yyyy-MM-dd'), DraggableJobCard (useDraggable), and DragOverlay from @dnd-kit/core in exactly this pattern
Role check: read user.role from useAuth() context; only render DndContext and attach drag attributes when role is 'Admin' or 'Dispatcher'

Time preservation: convert existing scheduledStart to Helsinki time with toLocaleTimeString('fi-FI', { timeZone: 'Europe/Helsinki', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false }), extract HH:MM, append to the target date string, then convert to UTC via new Date()
Optimistic state: derive a local useState copy of displayJobs; update it on dragEnd before awaiting the PATCH; on catch restore the pre-drag copy and set a local errorMessage state
axiosInstance is imported from frontend/src/api/axios.ts — do not use fetch or a different axios instance
PATCH payload shape: { scheduledStart: string } — send only scheduledStart; leave scheduledEnd unchanged (same as DispatcherBoard pattern)
CSS Modules only: add .weekDayColOver (highlight color when a draggable hovers) and .weekJobCardDragging (reduced opacity on the source card) to JobsPage.module.css
Droppable day column id must be the ISO date string of that day (e.g. '2026-06-23') to compute the new scheduledStart on drop
securityConsiderations: Frontend role check (Admin/Dispatcher only drag) is a UX guard; PATCH /api/jobs/:id/schedule enforces the same restriction server-side
No user data stored in localStorage or sessionStorage — auth token handling is already managed by axiosInstance
